quotes.speaker: James St. James
quotes.context: James on summer 1987: Julie won Face at a Harlem ball and led the club kids uptown
quotes.quote: I remember in 1987, it was the summer of '87, and Julie Jewels had gone up to the Elks Lodge and she won Face and came down with the trophy at like four in the morning to the Tunnel and said, you guys, there's this thing happening up in Harlem. It is amazing... And then we all went on an expedition... all the club kids went together and we called ourselves the House of Pancakes. And we were not welcome.
quotes.transcript: I remember in 1987, it was the summer of 87, and Julie Jules had gone up to the Elks Lodge and she won face and came down with the trophy at like four in the morning to the tunnel and said, You guys, there's this thing happening up in Harlem. It is amazing. Is this whole scene, and we didn't know anything? ... And then we all went on an expedition. ... It was, we, all the club kids, went together and we called ourselves the House of Pancakes. And we were not welcome.

quotes.context: Michelle on being played against Julie on the ball scene
quotes.quote: We both had our blonde ponytails, and nobody did it first, but there was a little bit of competition between me and Julie. But I was a voguer. Julie wasn't, but they wanted to put us against each other because we had similar looks: the pale skin, the blonde ponytail.

quotes.speaker: Dianne Brill
quotes.context: Dianne on her ex dressing Julie up to look like her
quotes.quote: He would take a girl that looks sort of like me in some way, and there was a girl, Julie Jewels, I know she was a friend of yours, beautiful girl, right? Beautiful. And he would start dressing her up like me... I never got to know her because I didn't like that he had done that. So it wasn't her. It was him.
